description: Runs plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::refresh_model_capability_catalog once with trigger='cron' (live fetches from the two Artificial Analysis sources), then classifies the model capability catalog ok/warning/critical. CRITICAL: the refresh raised or returned a failure, recorded any failed source, no cell is accepted, or the oldest accepted cell is older than the staleness window the cells themselves carry (the tightest staleness_window_hours, read from the catalog and never hard-coded). WARNING: the run renewed no accepted cell (no accepted cell has a newer measured_at than before the run), or the oldest accepted cell is older than 48 hours (capped at the window). On a severity TRANSITION (status differs from the last status an alert was delivered for, including the recovery back to ok) it dispatches plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::peer_send_by_name to the durable role named by this plugin's 'alert_role' config key and inspects the delivery: only queued_wake, queued_notification and queued_watcher count as reaching a live holder. The alert names the run counts, the oldest accepted cell age and the failed sources, and says the selector still works from the last accepted readings. With no alert_role configured the refresh still runs, the call logs at ERROR and returns alerted=false with alert_reason='alert_target_unconfigured'. An undelivered transition leaves the durable marker where it was, so the next call retries it; repeated calls at an unchanged status do not re-alert. The messaging plugin being unavailable raises instead of reporting ok. Not discoverable via search (is_discoverable=False) because it reaches the network; the daily schedule fires check_model_capability_catalog_cron.
embedding_description: Model capability catalog renewal guard. Refreshes the capability catalog from its live sources, then classifies it ok, warning or critical from failed sources, whether any accepted cell was renewed, and the age of the oldest accepted cell against the catalog's own staleness window. Alerts a configured durable role once per severity change, including recovery.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: status (ok|warning|critical), reasons, refresh_failure, readings_gathered, cells_accepted, cells_conflicted, cells_unchanged, sources_failed, renewed (bool), accepted_cell_count, oldest_cell_age_hours, staleness_window_hours, transitioned (bool), alerted (bool -- true only on a live-delivered transition alert), alert_role, alert_reason (set when transitioned is true and alerted is false: alert_target_unconfigured or a delivery-failure reason).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status, then the cell counts and oldest_cell_age_hours against staleness_window_hours. If transitioned is true and alerted is false, surface alert_reason prominently: a real severity change had nobody to tell.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: The check failed before it could classify the catalog: agent_messaging_plugin could not be resolved, the state service returned a non-completed status, or a catalog row was malformed. Distinct from a completed call that reports status=critical because the refresh itself failed, which is a normal, fully-handled outcome.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A raised exception means missing orchestrator wiring, a state-service outage, or an unreadable catalog row; it says nothing about whether the catalog is fresh.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm platform startup finished and the state-management provider is healthy before calling again. Not retryable by the platform: a retry would run a second live refresh.
